purpose: Continue only ordinary protein-shortening benchmarks; exclude pathogen, toxin, virulence and antimicrobial-resistance targets and partners.
unknown_policy: HOLD; absence of a keyword is not permission
general_review_basis: Existing UniProt organism and protein-description records reviewed individually: ordinary cellular metabolism, ribosomal/housekeeping functions, photosynthesis and fluorescent reporter; no viral, toxin or resistance targets. This is a bounded computational scope review, not a biosafety certification.
application_review_basis: Native mmCIF polymer entities, source organisms and descriptions for design chain AND every partner. Ordinary mammalian complexes, albumin/avian lysozyme binders, plant/yeast/animal metabolism and explicitly identified nonpathogenic laboratory/environmental housekeeping enzymes.
application_generation_gate: Still requires exact chain-to-polymer audit plus per-accession functional metadata; this review alone does not release application GPU jobs.
retrieval_generation_gate: Do not release RAG jobs until evidence-source scope is checked; unknown evidence is omitted with explicit fallback accounting.
former_fixed_counts: General100/Binder20/Enzyme20 are source-cohort labels only; screened denominators must be reported explicitly. Do not silently fill vacancies or retain old N.
